DHCPv4::xid
       This command returns xid(transaction ID) field from DHCPv4 message.

SYNOPSIS
       DHCPv4::xid

DESCRIPTION
       This command returns xid(transaction ID) field from DHCPv4 message

       Details (syntax): DHCPv4::xid

RETURN VALUE
       This command returns xid(transaction ID) field from DHCPv4 message

VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
	when CLIENT_DATA {
	    log local0. "Xid [DHCPv4::xid]"
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.6.0
	    --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
